summary: Users reported that the flxtime.fun project abruptly shut down its console Discord and social media channels after operating for over a year and recently launching an NFT mint. The sudden disappearance left token holders unable to access the platform or recover value.
user_mistake: continuing to invest and participate in a project without verifying transparency and liquidity controls
prevention: Verify smart contract liquidity locks and team transparency before investing and avoid projects that lack publicly auditable safeguards
